flaws.description: Replaced the y-axis label 'Elderly Survival Rate (%)' with 'Life Expectancy at Birth (years)' to misrepresent the plotted quantity.
Replaced the chart title with a factually incorrect but plausible alternative.
Changed Uruguay's 2022 survival rate from 79.3 to 173.4 (79.3 * 2.25, rounded to 1 decimal).
